0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (3-1, 3rd in the East) for an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Chicago on a three-game losing streak and 1-2 on the road. Boston is 3-0 at home and riding a three-game winning streak, while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Jalen Smith (finger) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 134-99 loss in Boston on October 26, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
